text:
jonathan: Quick sync — proposing a small model tweak for analytics.storage: add 'route_tags' (text[]) and migrate quota_bucket -> quota_key (uuid). This will touch console charts + quota service.
priya: TL;DR: why uuid? cost of joins with tenant_id + route_id cramped index?
jonathan: Two reasons: avoid surprise collisions when we start cross-tenant routing aliasing; also lets us store canonical quota policy id separate from route labels. Index size will increase but we can shard by tenant.
liam: Concern: existing dashboards do heavy GROUP BY quota_bucket; uuid will blow up cardinality and slow queries. We should maintain a compact denormalized 'quota_bucket_v1' varchar for fast aggregates.
eva: Agreed with liam. Proposal: keep alias column 'quota_bucket_v1' computed from (tenant, legacy_route) and keep new 'quota_key' uuid for canonical joins. Then dashboards can opt-in to v2.
priya: Migration plan? shadow writes? runbook? SLA windows?
jonathan: Plan: 1) schema add columns (nullable) 2) deploy apps to write both fields (shadow) 3) consumer libs release + console reads stay on v1 by default 4) run daily compare job for diffs 5) cutover after 2 weeks and monitor.
liam: SQL snippets?
jonathan: ```
ALTER TABLE analytics.events ADD COLUMN route_tags text[] DEFAULT ARRAY[]::text[];
ALTER TABLE analytics.events ADD COLUMN quota_key uuid;
-- write shadow to quota_key via service lib v2
```
eva: We should also add a small sampled prefix cache to reduce KV reads when computing quota_key on write. Otherwise we'll spike write-latency.
telemetry-bot: [alert] long-running migration note: remember to set low lock impacts (ADD COLUMN is fast), but large table updates will require chunked backfills.
jonathan: Yup. We'll use async backfill job that updates in batches per tenant with rate limit and checkpointing. Ops will have a 'migration' dashboard.
priya: For rollouts UX: console should show a deprecation banner if customer's charts still use v1. Also provide toggle to opt into v2 for early adopters.
liam: Add test: ensure quota calcs match within epsilon for 99th pct of routes before cutover.
eva: +1, and include query-plan snapshots pre/post cutover in alerting.
deploy-bot: Deploy scheduled: migration-scripts v1 -> v2 queued for 2026-03-25 02:00 UTC
jonathan: I'll open a short runbook doc and add the migration IDs. Thanks all :raised_hands:
